scope: Independent review of the root-authored marginal-dollar decision pair: information versus development rank, retained-value objective, staged cost assumptions, source-content limits, hepatic/competitor inference, asymmetric functional interpretation, closure and restrictions.

basis.scope: Recovered independent-review passages in session context, including BLU rank, qualification and additional conditional-function envelopes; checked against Round18 context. Analytical input, not measured cost or efficacy.
Current inherited marginal-dollar, claim-specific, asymmetric-result and scope-change rules.
Companion source/provenance narrative read for consistency; manuscript metadata are distinguished from unread PDF content.
Structured source limits and no new human-force evidence reviewed; this decision review does not bind the companion file.
Underlying finite primary liver audit previously performed by this reviewer; Inoue abstract and EXCEL sponsor plan limits checked directly against decision language.
Competitor auditor's primary-source extraction and stage-cost challenge reviewed for consistency. Underlying sponsor sources were not reread in this cross-review.
Parent, candidate, two-stage budget/rank context and restrictions checked.

findings.finding: The objective includes the next decision's information value, remaining cost/time/clinical risk and retained economics. Historical effort and the old55-point allocation are not treated as EV evidence.
BLU information-sprint rank1 is kept distinct from the independent review development rank3. APR1/RM2/BLU3 is preserved; source closure does not automatically demote APR/RM or promote BLU.

The $60–180k/3–6-month qualification assumption is separate from an additional conditional $100–300k/4–8-month functional phase. No combined validated budget, guaranteed timing, quote, success probability or spending commitment is asserted.

The general rights/licensing, GLP, GMP clinical manufacture, clinical trial and commercialization exclusions remain explicit. Major model/chemistry/systemic/rights expansion requires a new marginal comparison including waiting.

The Kora deposit is a metadata/provenance update for an existing paper; unread manuscript content is not converted into a new force endpoint, independent cohort, qualified access or actual project price.

The Inoue observation retains two patients and two muscle/one liver specimens. One normal liver enzyme assessment does not clear hepatobiliary disease, BLU safety or systemic exposure and does not create a universal new gate.

EXCEL remains a dated prospective plan with unverified current status, actual enrollment, outcomes and access. The decision neither counts planned people as observed patients nor initiates a parallel study.

ASP2957 claims remain sponsor program/nonclinical and follow-up detail without a recovered clinical efficacy or direct BLU comparison. No safer human product, permanent liver-ineligible market or measured residual commercial population is inferred.
The TAM4MTM update is described as no recovered completed efficacy dataset; old reporting disagreement and distinct-drug adverse events are not promoted into fresh BLU failure.

A credible interpretable within-background functional positive can justify confirmation before every delayed-control/systemic module is complete. The post-deficit modifiability requirement is now explicitly limited to an intended reversal claim in JSONB3, matching the narrative.

Model/article/exposure failure stays separate from target failure. A qualified narrow negative can constrain its article/window while broader target rejection needs selective and independent support; preservation and ongoing benefit retain their own claim scope.

Public-source closure is not scientific rejection. Reopening conditions name substantive documents/data/facts, and all prior generic exposure, model/catalog, patent and other closed lanes remain closed.
No numerical EV/NPV, replacement allocation, new S-tier, human BLU efficacy, experimental result or execution authority is created. All activity flags and route/branch execution flags are false.

resolved_issues.issue: JSONB3 originally left post-deficit modifiability as a generic prerequisite for interpreting any negative result, although the narrative correctly scoped it to reversal.
resolved_issues.correction: Root qualified the condition with 'for an intended reversal claim' while keeping article/exposure/deficit/precision limits general.
resolved_issues.verification: Final JSON branch B3 and narrative were reread before binding; no universal delayed-reversal gate remains.

open_issues.issue: Exact human-force route, transferable article/exposure/selectivity, credible cost and execution capacity remain unqualified.
open_issues.status: Explicit decision inputs, not defects in the source-pass conclusion.

open_issues.issue: The new institutional manuscript remains unread; its model details and the deposited file's version are not independently established by this review.
open_issues.status: Metadata-only limit preserved, with companion evidence carrying the detailed version-label discrepancy.

open_issues.status: No safety, adverse-effect or niche assertion is inferred from these gaps.
